threats.title: SSRF, redirects, DNS rebinding and cloud metadata access
threats.control: Resolve and pin public IPs; block loopback/private/link-local/metadata ranges before every hop; egress allow policy; adversarial tests.

threats.title: Tenant spoofing or cross-tenant data access
threats.control: Bind tenant server-side; repository-wide scoped access layer; DB-enforced isolation; negative matrix.

threats.title: Privilege escalation, confused deputy and reviewer impersonation
threats.control: Central authorization; separate human identities and reviewer roles; non-self-certification checks.

threats.title: Credential leakage or overbroad custody
threats.control: Managed secrets, rotation, least privilege, redaction, leak scanning and revocation drills.

threats.title: Prompt injection and poisoned website or tool results
threats.control: Treat content as data; constrained schemas; provenance; instruction stripping; human decision gates.

threats.title: Artifact substitution, enumeration or stale revision approval
threats.control: Immutable hashes and current-revision checks exist for assessments; extend exact binding and opaque scoped identifiers to all artifacts/jobs.

threats.title: Approval or evidence forgery, replay, rollback or audit tampering
threats.control: Signed append-only evidence, monotonic decisions, replay keys, independent custody and restore verification.

threats.title: Job forgery, duplicate processing, races and crash-window replay
threats.control: Atomic claims exist; add durable queue, leases, idempotency, fencing, deterministic retries and duplicate tests.

threats.title: SHA or CI bypass and malicious PR or tool
threats.control: Exact-head CI exists; require protected branches, pinned trusted actions, provenance, review separation and fail-closed merge policy.

threats.title: Sentinel suppression or fabricated health
threats.control: Independent liveness, alert delivery, immutable telemetry and suppression detection; current status endpoint is not certification.

threats.title: Outbound PII exfiltration through configured webhook or model
threats.control: Destination allowlist, data minimization, signed webhook, tenant policy, audit and provider contracts.

threats.title: Malicious dependency or CI runner compromises source and evidence
threats.control: Pin actions and dependencies, SBOM/license review, isolated runners, minimal tokens and artifact attestations.
